summary: XOMA Royalty Corp filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No.1 to its April 27, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger, whereby a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ligand Pharmaceuticals Incorporated will merge into a newly formed Nevada corporation, XOMA Royalty Holdings Corporation (HoldCo), making HoldCo a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. The amendment adds HoldCo as a party. No price per share, premium, or timeline are disclosed. The deal requires stockholder approval and a definitive proxy statement will be filed. The board's recommendation is not stated. What to watch: stockholder vote and regulatory clearance; risk-arb spreads will depend on disclosed consideration.
